event.title: Court Denies Biden's Request to Block Release of Ghostwriter Interview Recordings
event.canonical_title: Court Denies Biden's Request to Block Release of Ghostwriter Interview Recordings
event.summary: A federal appeals court has denied Joe Biden's request to prevent the release of audio recordings and transcripts from his interviews with a ghostwriter prior to his presidency. The court's 2-1 ruling emphasized the significant public interest in disclosing these materials, which are to be provided to a conservative think tank.

timeline.title: Court Denies Biden's Request to Block Release of Ghostwriter Interview Recordings
timeline.summary: A US appeals court has rejected Joe Biden's attempt to block the release of recordings from interviews with his memoir ghostwriter. The divided three-judge panel ruled that there is a significant public interest in disclosing the material. The decision is currently suspended until August 3, allowing Biden time to consider a further appeal.
key_facts: US appeals court rejected Biden's request to block release of ghostwriter recordings.
The ruling was a 2-1 decision by a three-judge panel.
The court found substantial public interest in the recordings.
